registry_info.description: Physics play: Jolt set-ups for the Transformation floors, a precursor to the Logic sequence's artifacts (Palle, 2026-11-03).

physics_play_plank_ball.name: Physics play / Plank on a ball
physics_play_plank_ball.description: A plank laid across a ball on a mat: balance that cannot last. Press one end (RELEASE) or take the plank and lay it again. Real Jolt bodies, grabbable and throwable on desktop and in XR; RESET puts them back.

physics_play_tyre_boxes.name: Physics play / Tyre and boxes
physics_play_tyre_boxes.description: A tyre held at the top of a ramp; RELEASE lets it roll into a stack of four boxes. The tyre chain of the Matter and Logic port, without the logic: only the contact. Real Jolt bodies, grabbable and throwable on desktop and in XR; RESET puts them back.

physics_play_dominoes.name: Physics play / Dominoes
physics_play_dominoes.description: Nine slabs in a row; one push (RELEASE) passes along. Stand them again by hand. Real Jolt bodies, grabbable and throwable on desktop and in XR; RESET puts them back.

physics_play_stack.name: Physics play / A stack and a ball
physics_play_stack.description: A tower of five boxes and a ball thrown at it (RELEASE): what holds a tower up, and what does not. Real Jolt bodies, grabbable and throwable on desktop and in XR; RESET puts them back.

physics_play_pendulum.name: Physics play / Pendulum
physics_play_pendulum.description: A bob on a real hinge, 1.6 m from its pivot. RELEASE lets it go from 40 degrees; the console times the swing against 2 pi sqrt(L / g). Real Jolt bodies, grabbable and throwable on desktop and in XR; RESET puts them back.

physics_play_seesaw.name: Physics play / Seesaw
physics_play_seesaw.description: A plank on a fulcrum with a light box on one end; RELEASE drops a heavy box on the other and throws the light one. Real Jolt bodies, grabbable and throwable on desktop and in XR; RESET puts them back.

physics_play_ramp_race.name: Physics play / Ramp race
physics_play_ramp_race.description: A ball, a cylinder and a box let go together down one slope (RELEASE): rolling against sliding; the console names who crosses the line first. Real Jolt bodies, grabbable and throwable on desktop and in XR; RESET puts them back.

physics_play_extinguisher_ramp.name: Physics play / Extinguisher and boxes
physics_play_extinguisher_ramp.description: Built from the inventory: the fire extinguisher (fire_extinguisher = association(config(cylinder)), a term of the modular grammar) held on its side at the top of a ramp, and three of the inventory's own cardboard boxes stacked at its foot. RELEASE: it rolls into them. Real Jolt bodies, grabbable; RESET puts them back.

physics_play_propped_ramp.name: Physics play / A propped ramp
physics_play_propped_ramp.description: Built from the inventory: two cinder blocks (association(cube)) prop a wooden board (association(quad)) as a ramp; the oil drum (association(config(cylinder))) held at its top rolls into a pyramid of tin cans. Cinder blocks are what props things up. Real Jolt bodies, grabbable; RESET puts them back.

physics_play_tin_can_alley.name: Physics play / Tin-can alley
physics_play_tin_can_alley.description: Built from the inventory: a wooden board across two cinder blocks is the shelf; ten tin cans stand on it, 4-3-2-1; RELEASE throws the rubber ball. Real Jolt bodies, grabbable; RESET puts them back.

physics_play_bowling.name: Physics play / Bowling
physics_play_bowling.description: Built from the inventory: ten bowling pins (association(config(revolve))) in their triangle; RELEASE rolls the rubber ball, at a bowling ball's 5 kg. Real Jolt bodies, grabbable; RESET puts them back.

physics_play_marble_run.name: Physics play / Marble run
physics_play_marble_run.description: Built from the inventory: the marble chute (association(config(channel))) propped on a cinder block; RELEASE lets five marbles go. The road to the Logic sequence's marble machines. Real Jolt bodies, grabbable; RESET puts them back.
